Evidence of revenue acceleration and narrowing operating losses in Q3 and Q4 2026 results will determine whether Diginex can extend runway organically or faces dilutive capital raises.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: lime green. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: two paper calendar pages; a paper hand.
Opens on the extended runway, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: Two paper calendar pages land on the runway; a paper hand enters and points at the second.
Ends holding on the pointing hand.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "NEXT 2 QUARTERS".

COPY LIST: "NEXT 2 QUARTERS". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Survival depends on capital markets; the next two quarters show whether revenue can narrow the gap.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage with a bold magazine composition. The entire shot features a dominant, flat block-color background in lime green with a consistent matte texture. The lighting is fixed from the upper-left, creating small, subtle paper-layer shadows beneath all elements. The scene opens on a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an extended runway with rough white torn-paper edges. Immediately, two rectangular paper calendar pages—also black-and-white halftone cutouts with rough white torn edges—enter the frame quickly from the top, landing on the runway with a slight overshoot before settling into a stable position. Simultaneously, a large, black-and-white halftone paper cutout of an anonymous hand enters from the right edge of the frame and points its index finger decisively at the second calendar page. A large, extra-bold sans-serif headline "NEXT 2 QUARTERS" is printed in black ink on a cream-colored paper chip, positioned with safe margins in the composition. All elements are flat matte printed paper with visible print dots and no glows or gradients. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. As the animation reaches the end, the elements hold a clear reading window with a very subtle, slow looping drift to maintain visual life. An English narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, speaks starting on the first frame: <d>[English] Survival depends on capital markets; the next two quarters show whether revenue can narrow the gap.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the clear voice of the narrator. Layered beneath the speech are crisp, tactile diegetic sound effects: the sharp, dry slap of heavy paper landing on a surface and the subtle, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down.
